name: Sanctum Infinity (S Controller)
not_assessed: how many keys it takes to move it
the time anyone has to react
the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: Two paths bind the score: a 6-of-11 Squads v3 program upgrade and a 4-of-8 Squads v4 pool admin with no delay, which decides how every LST is valued.
narrative.detail: The pool admin can call SetSolValueCalculator and SetPricingProgram, which decide how each LST is valued; the seven calculator and pricing programs share the same upgrade authority. The rebalance authority is a single on-curve key but bounded: EndRebalance must follow in the same transaction and rejects any drop in pool SOL value, so it is disclosed and not scored. DefiLlama listed over $150M TVL on 2026-09-17.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
main_gap.reason: Changes can apply with no waiting time

independent_read.path: program -> ProgramData ALmAxh… -> upgrade authority (a program-derived address, off the curve: a Squads vault or a protocol PDA, no key can sign for it directly)
independent_read.posture: admin: a program-derived address (not a Squads v4 vault); delay: unknown
